description: Published, bounded per-ticker multiplier adjustment from ml-forecaster/publish.py, applied on top of the normal graded-ladder multiplier in near_close_dca.graded_buy_multiplier. status must be 'active' and generated_at fresher than max_staleness_hours for any adjustment to apply; otherwise every ticker is treated as 1.0 (no-op). See docs/ticker_advisory.md Phase 2.
